rationale: Maintains a relentless monster-rally voice with ALL-CAPS cadence, escalating stakes, and spectacle applied to mundane details (e.g., Deacon Bob's SEVEN-LAYER DIP, DEMOLITION DERBY of DESSERTS). The only minor flaw is a clipped ending but voice never really breaks.
quote: The First Baptist Church presents... THE FELLOWSHIP HALL POTLUCK OF DESTINYYYY!
